name: Trap808
description: Trap drum machine with rolling hi-hats and a sliding 808 bass. Hold the pad to run. X = hat density/rolls (8ths → 16ths → 32nd/triplet bursts), Y = 808 root pitch. Top-right flick = one-bar hat fill.

params.name: HATS
params.detail: Hi-hat density: 8ths → 16ths with velocity → 32nd rolls and triplets

params.name: DRIVE
params.detail: Saturation / punch on the 808 and kick
